title: Three women we remember with love
intro: Today we remember three women, from Lombardy, Lazio and Emilia-Romagna. We share only what trusted sources have told us, and we hold them in our thoughts with gratitude.

women.name: A woman from Vigevano
tribute: She was a woman from Vigevano, in Lombardy, and she is in our thoughts.

women.name: A woman from Ceprano
tribute: She was 90 years old and came from Ceprano, in Lazio. She is in our thoughts.

women.name: A woman from Ponte Samoggia
tribute: She was 50 years old and is remembered in Ponte Samoggia, in Emilia-Romagna. She is in our thoughts.
